card.name: Partway through rarer long words
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of rarer words split into several parts, such as the 'ies' in quiescent, 'ens' in pollens, or 'kal' in Alkaloids. It fires right after a word's opening letters, before the word is finished.

modes.label: Medical words split midway
modes.description: A middle piece inside a longer drug or medical term.

modes.label: Other uncommon words
modes.description: A middle piece of an uncommon general or proper word.

card.plain: It reacts when a long or unusual word is cut into pieces and the model is only partway through reading it.
